items.title: “AI가 쇼핑 다 해주면 광고는 누가 보나”…네이버·아마존, 문 걸어잠근다
items.excerpt: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse agent from shopping on its site, and Naver and Coupang are also cutting off outside AI agents. Agents that search and pay on a user's behalf skip the platform's ad slots, recommendations and lock-in. Google, Walmart and Shopify are going the other way and opening checkout to agents (UCP, a shared standard for agent identity and delegated permissions).
items.keyword: agentic checkout / 쿠팡 AI / 네이버 AI 쇼핑
items.note: Shares the Muse-vs-Amazon thread with the 'Meta shopping agent merchants' spare, but leads with Korean platforms (Naver, Coupang) and the ad-exposure stakes

items.title: 네카오, AI 수익화 경쟁 본격화…이용자 4000만 정조준
items.excerpt: Naver's AI Briefing ads, launched in late July, get a click-through rate 30%+ above standard search ads and more than 3x the purchase conversion. AI drove over 60% of Naver's Q2 ad revenue growth. Kakao plans to route intent from KakaoTalk conversations into ordering and payment through its agents, and to monetize AI from next year, targeting double-digit AI share of Talk Biz revenue by 2028.
items.keyword: 네이버 AI 브리핑 광고 / 카카오 AI 광고

items.title: 비용 줄이려다 손님도 줄어드네…소비자들 외면하는 AI 광고
items.excerpt: Korean consumers are pushing back against ad photos and videos made with generative AI: AI-generated fashion models, food photos on menus, AI video ads on YouTube and in theaters. They say the ads kill the urge to buy and lower trust. Experts cite research showing that the more AI shoppers perceive in an ad's production, the less authentic it seems.

items.title: 데이터라이즈, AI에 마케팅 '판단' 맡긴다 [디지털마케팅 대전]
items.excerpt: Datarize, a CRM marketing AI platform for direct-to-consumer e-commerce stores (about 1,000 clients), is moving its AI from running campaigns to diagnosing why sales dropped and recommending fixes. Its analysis of 880 clients found falling traffic caused only half of the 10%+ sales declines, and 78% of repeat decliners had a different cause each time. A Slack-style agent is in beta.
items.keyword: Klaviyo/HubSpot-style CRM AI / AI 마케팅 솔루션
items.note: Vendor-profile series; has first-party data, but check for advertorial tone

items.title: OpenAI Is Turning Creators Into Testers for Agentic AI
items.excerpt: OpenAI is partnering with creator Chloe Shih (Office Drama) on a parenting series, with her as an early user of 'dots', its always-on agent. The deal makes the creator part of how the product gets tested and positioned rather than paying her for a standard sponsored post, a different template for brand-creator deals in AI.
items.note: Weak; the ad/sales hook is indirect
